question: Who wrote the medieval-era epic poem “Padmavat"?
solution:
The correct answer is **Malik Muhammad Jayasi**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Malik Muhammad Jayasi** wrote the epic poem "Padmavat" in 1540.
 
• The poem is a fictionalized account of the siege of Chittor by Alauddin Khilji in 1303.
 
• "Padmavat" is written in the Awadhi language and is considered a significant work in Indian literature.
 
• The poem blends elements of history, legend, and folklore, focusing on the beauty and valor of Queen Padmini.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 Mulla Daud
 He was a 14th-century Indian poet known for his work "Chandayan".
 
 

 Malik Muhammad Jayasi
 He was a 16th-century Indian Sufi poet who wrote "Padmavat".
 
 

 Abu'l-Fazl ibn Mubarak
 He was a court historian of Akbar and author of the "Akbarnama".
 
 

 Amir Khusro
 He was a Sufi musician, poet, and scholar from India, known for his Persian and Hindavi poetry.
